title: Cad Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: W2 of the crate consolidation & plugin taxonomy restructure. Merge 📐️cad's 8 constitutional Rust crates (semio-s-plugin-cad bundle + semio-s-app-cad{,-engine,-op,-dsl,-pack,-protocol,-ui}) into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📐️cad/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ named semio-s-plugin-cad, with the full taxonomy source tree (🗿️artifacts/📐️cad/{🔺️diff,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,🔧️op,📡️spr,⚙️engine}, 🎛️apps/📐️cad/{🎮️commands,🎭️modes,🪟️windows,📌️panels,…}) per the master ticket's discovery contract and 📋️TEMPLATE.md's recipe. Preserve all [package.metadata.*] verbatim (component package semio:cad, playground ports react 6020 / wgpu 6120, cad-fixture asset row). Verify cargo check (native + wasm32-wasip2), clippy -D warnings, cargo test with wire-format byte-diff proof, then delete old crate manifests. Registrar handles root Cargo.toml.
summary:
W2 of the crate-consolidation restructure: merged 📐️cad's 8 constitutional Rust crates (semio-s-plugin-cad bundle + semio-s-app-cad{,-engine,-op,-dsl,-pack,-protocol,-ui}, 9172 lines) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-cad` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📐️cad/📦️packages/🦀️rust with the full taxonomy tree (41 source files): 🗿️artifacts/📐️cad/{🦀️component,🦀️interaction_spec,🔺️diff,🔧️op,🗣️dsl,🎒️pack,📡️spr,⚙️engine{component,geometry_import,transformation,interaction,construct}} and 🎛️apps/📐️cad/{🦀️component,🦀️config,🦀️terminology,🦀️wasm, 12 🎮️commands groups decomposing all 47 CadCommand variants via app_commands!, 3 📌️panels, 🎭️modes/✏️edit with 4 🪟️windows and 3 mode-level 🎚️options}. 📦️lib.rs is wiring-only (#[path] mods + semio_plugin!).

Verification (all green, run against the new crate in isolation via a temporary nested-[workspace] overlay, since the old bundle crate still owned the package name until deletion): cargo check native 0 warnings; cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2 0 warnings; cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings 0 findings (67 pre-existing map_unwrap_or/redundant_clone/chunks_exact/needless_pass_by_value findings rode along with the moved code and were fixed); cargo test 125 passed / 0 failed (baseline was 51 from the 6 crates that compiled). Wire format proven byte-identical by before/after print_op|len|hex dumps: 69 CadCommand rows and 16 CadOperation + 2 CadConfigOperation rows all diff-clean; the only change anywhere is serde_json's shape for the 5 fieldless commands ("EngagementAbort" -> {"EngagementAbort":{}}), which is unused on any wire (the codec is protocol::OpBinary/dsl::DslOps). Permanent wire guards (every_command()/every_operation() laws + pinned hex) kept in the app component and the op node. Taxonomy audit (mirror of validateTaxonomyTree) clean. wasm32-wasip2 component built and jco-transpiled successfully (exports semio:framework/plugin).

Found and repaired a PRE-EXISTING breakage: semio-s-app-cad-ui was committed broken at HEAD (fa51b5c82f) with 51 rustc parse errors — a repo-wide automated edit had wrapped DocumentApp::handle's match arms in `Ok(` without closing parens, left Emit::amend_config arms unwrapped, and never imported Fault. All 67 of that crate's tests now run for the first time (only rename: context_menu_is_grouped_and_keeps_deleteObject_last -> ..._delete_object_last for non_snake_case).

All [package.metadata.*] preserved verbatim (component package semio:cad, playground variant cad / app cad-play / ports react 6020 wgpu 6120, /cad-fixture static-dir asset row) so launch.json regeneration is a no-op. Old crate manifests deleted only after 1-4 passed. Cross-cutting edit: the framework dsl fixture-sweep crate's cad_document dev-dependency repointed from semio-s-app-cad to semio-s-plugin-cad (use cad_document::artifacts::cad::CadScene), matching the writer/vcs/animate precedent already in that file.

REGISTRAR HANDOFF (see 📋️registrar-handoff.md): remove root Cargo.toml member lines 458 + 460-466 (8 old cad crates; line 459 is demonstrator's, keep it), add "✏️s/🔌️plugins/📐️cad/📦️packages/🦀️rust", and drop the [workspace.dependencies] row semio-s-app-cad (line 693). NOT-EDITED cross-plugin dependents flagged: (1) 🎪️demonstrator depends on semio-s-app-cad + -engine + -ui — all three collapse to one semio-s-plugin-cad dep when demonstrator migrates last; (2) 💠️lowpoly's engine crate DEV-depends on semio-s-app-cad-engine for one test module — not flagged anywhere in the plan/TEMPLATE, needs a scoped repoint to semio-s-plugin-cad (cad_plugin::artifacts::cad::engine::geometry_import::*); only cargo test -p semio-s-app-lowpoly-engine is affected, lib builds are fine.

TEMPLATE gap reported: TEMPLATE.md places 🎚️options under each 🪟️window (flow had one window). cad has 4 world-3d windows sharing the same 3 option kinds, so the option components live once at 🎭️modes/✏️edit/🎚️options/{🎥️projection,🌞️sun,🕹️dislocate} and each window binds them by pane — 3 files instead of 12 near-duplicates. This passes validateTaxonomyTree (which only constrains what may appear UNDER a window dir) and the root script.ts taxonomy policy lints.
